columns.comment: Calendar month of the exposure month-end as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01' (the month-end snapshot as of 30-Sep-2026). This view is monthly; point-in-time measures grouped by a longer period (quarter, half, fiscal year) return its last month. The latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the exposure month-end, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Always true here: this view is monthly, every row is a month-end snapshot or a whole-month total (kept so the same filter works in daily and monthly views).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: The group's lead (relationship) legal entity, e.g. the entity holding the account plan.
columns.name: Lead Client

columns.comment: Group segment (most common segment of its APAC clients): Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Group relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic groups" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for groups headquartered in Japan (Japanese corporate groups) - "Japanese corporates" / "JC" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Group industry sector (most common sector of its APAC clients), e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Group industry subsector (most common subsector of its APAC clients), e.g. Automotive Parts, Shipping.
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: Lead office of the group = coverage office of its lead entity, ISO-2 code (SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand).
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Group lead RM = current primary RM of the group's lead entity (fictional name).
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the group lead RM sits - "RMs in Singapore" means this.
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Worst (highest) internal rating grade 1-10 among the group's rated APAC clients today; null = no rated client.
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: Highest IFRS 9 stage (1-3) among the group's APAC clients today.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when at least one APAC client of the group is on the credit watchlist today.
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating (Low, Medium, High) of the group's lead entity today; null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Worst current early-warning band among the group's APAC clients (Red > Amber > Green); null = none scored.
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Where the relationship is booked: APAC (SMBC APAC), JP (Tokyo HO / Japan, incl. the Japanese parent), EMEA or AMER (regional subsidiaries). "Including Japan, EMEA and Americas" = all four regions.
columns.name: Region

columns.comment: APAC coverage office (ISO-2, e.g. SG, HK) for APAC rows, or the provider region JP / EMEA / AMER.
columns.name: Booking Entity

columns.comment: Product family: Corporate Lending, Structured Lending, Sustainable Finance, Trade Finance, Cash, Liquidity, Payments, FX, Rates or Other TB & Advisory.
columns.name: Product Family

columns.comment: Legal entity of the group in the region (APAC client, Japanese parent, JP-booked entity or EMEA / AMER subsidiary).
columns.name: Entity

columns.comment: APAC legal entity, JP Parent, Group Entity (JP-booked), EMEA subsidiary or AMER subsidiary.
columns.name: Entity Type

columns.comment: Committed limits at the month-end in USD across the selected regions.
columns.name: Global Committed USD

columns.comment: Drawn / outstanding exposure at the month-end in USD (APAC - drawn loans plus live trade instruments).
columns.name: Global Drawn USD

columns.comment: Deposit balances at the month-end in USD across the selected regions.
columns.name: Global Deposits USD

columns.comment: Revenue over the 12 months to the month-end in USD (APAC revenue history from Apr-2024).
columns.name: Global Revenue 12M USD

columns.comment: Revenue over the 12 months to the month-end booked in SMBC APAC, USD.
columns.name: APAC Revenue 12M USD

columns.comment: APAC revenue 12M / global group revenue 12M (fraction); below 0.20 = APAC earns less than 20% of the group.
columns.name: APAC Share of Group Revenue %

columns.comment: Revenue earned in the selected months in USD - a flow, adds up over months.
columns.name: Revenue in Period USD

columns.comment: Legal entities of the group with business in the selected regions at the month-end.
columns.name: Entity Count

columns.comment: Client groups with business at the month-end.
columns.name: Groups

comment: Global relationship of each client group by region at each month-end, Apr-2023 to Sep-2026 (USD): committed limits, drawn exposure, deposits and revenue over the trailing 12 months for SMBC APAC (golden clients), Japan (the Japanese parent and JP-booked group entities, Tokyo HO share) and the EMEA / AMER subsidiaries (regional shares), the APAC share of group revenue and the number of entities. Balances and Revenue 12M are POINT-IN-TIME: filter one Month (Is Latest Month = Sep 2026) - a longer period returns its last month; Revenue in the Period is a flow. Group attributes (segment, tier, lead office, lead RM) come from the group master. Grain: one row per entity x region x product family x month-end (gold.fact_group_global_exposure_monthly).
